properties.name: viewModelInstanceId
properties.description: Identifier of the view model instance this value is for, at runtime this is expected in context (after) a ViewModelInstance object.

properties.name: viewModelPropertyId
properties.description: Identifier of the property this value will provide data for. At runtime these ids are normalized relative to the ViewModel itself.

properties.name: dependentIds
properties.description: List of integer ids for objects registered in the same context that depend on this object.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Non-unique identifier, used to give friendly names to elements in the hierarchy. Runtimes provide an API for finding components by this [name].

properties.name: exportName
properties.description: Flag to export the name property for runtime.

properties.name: parentId
properties.description: Identifier used to track parent ContainerComponent.

properties.name: childOrder
properties.description: Order value for sorting child elements in ContainerComponent parent.

properties.name: flags
properties.description: Component state. Runtime export folds visibility and selectable state into drawable flags; editor-only flags stay in the editor.
